events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 years since his death
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot dead in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, aged just 25.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty years ago today, we lost a true icon. Remembering Tupac Shakur and his incredible impact on music and culture. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 years since his passing
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died on this day in 1970 in London, aged 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His influence on guitar music is still felt today. What's your top Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road: 57 years old
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history! What's your go-to track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th Birthday to The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, born on this day in Akron, Ohio.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon and the voice of The Pretenders. What's your favourite song from her?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th Birthday to Oasis legend and solo artist, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in Manchester.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite track from the Oasis frontman? As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released 51 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track, on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates globally today. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: The original iPod: 25 years old
events.blurb: Apple launched the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? It's 25 years old today! The click wheel, the white headphones... it changed everything. What was on your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day Angle
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007? And who's your pick for the best Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, born on this day in Weston-super-Mare.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy, from Monty Python to Fawlty Towers. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album': 58 years old
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. Which track from the double album is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his death
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true legend. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury and his unparalleled stage presence and voice. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul': 61 years old
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that pushed their sound in new directions. What's your top track from it?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 years since his death
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, music icon John Lennon was tragically shot and killed in New York City, aged 40.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. We remember his incredible legacy today.
